verdict.rationale: dlt supports bulk/batch data movement inherently — loading full tables, incremental merges/upserts across many records, backfills, and schema evolution across many items (dlt-docs-18, dlt-docs-27, dlt-docs-49, dlt-docs-35) — and pipelines can be orchestrated/scheduled to run at scale (dlt-docs-59, dlt-docs-70, dlt-docs-11). However, this is bulk data-record processing, not clear evidence of an AI-native agent issuing bulk operations across many discrete 'items' (e.g., many sources, many pipelines, many files) in one command/interface beyond a single pipeline run. missing for 10: explicit documentation of batch/bulk operations across many pipelines, sources, or resources in a single agent-driven action, and independent/hands-on confirmation of bulk-scale reliability.
